points.title: 出生与成长
points.description: 施耐庵出生于江苏省淮安市，这里是他的故乡，也是他成长的地方。关于他的早年生活，史料记载不多，但可以推测他在这里接受了传统教育，并开始接触文学。他的家族背景可能对他的文学创作有一定影响。
points.descriptionEn: Shi Nai'an was born in Huai'an, Jiangsu Province, China, his hometown and place of upbringing. Little is known about his early life, but it is speculated that he received traditional education here and began to接触 literature. His family background may have had some influence on his literary creation.

points.title: 文学创作
points.description: 施耐庵在苏州市开始了他的文学创作生涯。在这里，他完成了《水浒传》的初稿。这部小说以其独特的艺术成就和深刻的社会意义，成为中国古典小说的巅峰之作，对后世文学产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: Shi Nai'an began his literary career in Suzhou, where he completed the first draft of 'Water Margin'. This novel, with its unique artistic achievements and profound social significance, has become a masterpiece of Chinese classical literature, exerting a profound influence on later literature.

points.title: 作品传播与影响
points.description: 施耐庵的《水浒传》在中国各地传播，深受读者喜爱。这部作品不仅在中国文学史上占有重要地位，而且对世界文学也产生了影响。它描绘了宋江等英雄好汉的故事，反映了当时社会的矛盾和人民的反抗精神。
points.descriptionEn: Shi Nai'an's 'Water Margin' spread throughout China and was deeply loved by readers. This work occupies an important position in the history of Chinese literature and also had an impact on world literature. It depicts the stories of heroes like Song Jiang and reflects the contradictions of the society and the spirit of the people's resistance at that time.

supporter.zh: 施耐庵被誉为中国古代小说家，他的《水浒传》是中国古典小说的巅峰之作，对后世文学产生了深远影响。他被认为是文学巨匠，其作品具有很高的艺术价值和历史价值。
supporter.en: Shi Nai'an is hailed as an ancient Chinese novelist, and his 'Water Margin' is considered the peak of Chinese classical novels, exerting a profound influence on later literature. He is regarded as a literary master, whose works have high artistic and historical value.

critic.zh: 一些学者认为，施耐庵在《水浒传》中过分夸大了英雄人物的形象，忽视了现实社会的复杂性。此外，他的作品也存在一些历史错误和道德争议。
critic.en: Some scholars believe that Shi Nai'an overemphasized the image of heroes in 'Water Margin', ignoring the complexity of the real society. Moreover, his works also contain some historical errors and moral controversies.

objective.zh: 施耐庵是明代著名的小说家，他的《水浒传》不仅在中国文学史上具有重要地位，而且对世界文学也产生了影响。他的作品反映了明代社会的某些方面，但同时也存在一定的局限性。
objective.en: Shi Nai'an was a famous novelist of the Ming Dynasty. His 'Water Margin' holds an important position in the history of Chinese literature and also had an impact on world literature. His works reflect certain aspects of the Ming Dynasty society, but also have certain limitations.

self.en: Life is like a dream, wealth and honor are like floating clouds.

others.zh: “施耐庵笔下的英雄，既有豪情壮志，又有悲欢离合，令人感慨万千。”
others.en: The heroes depicted by Shi Nai'an have both heroic ambitions and the joys and sorrows of life and separation, which makes people feel deeply moved.
